Docs.summary: The item, inline. For `text` and `query`: the text, up to 100,000 characters; text over the model's token limit (currently 8,192 tokens) isn't rejected: only its start is embedded, and the result is flagged with `truncated` and an `EMBEDDING_INPUT_TRUNCATED` warning. For `image`, only where the endpoint accepts inline images (off by default): a `data:image/...;base64,` URI or raw base64. The service never fetches URLs in `content`.

Docs.summary: Required with `url`: a user delegation SAS for that one blob (its query string, with or without a leading `?`): read-only (`sp=r`), for the blob (`sr=b`), https-only (`spr=https`), and signed by the identity that calls this API. A SAS valid for more than 15 minutes is accepted with warning `EMBEDDING_SAS_LONG_LIVED`. The service uses it for one read and never stores, logs or returns it.

Docs.summary: For `text` and `image` items, from Microsoft Entra callers, where enabled: the Azure Blob Storage URL of the blob to embed, `https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/{container}/{blob}`, with no query string. This is how images are sent by default. Text blobs are read as UTF-8, currently up to 1 MiB. Queries must be sent inline.
